brand.disclaimer: Crate Ranger is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with SoundScout, Monstercat or Create Music Group. Downloads are only possible within your own SoundScout plan.

login.title: Sign in to SoundScout
login.intro: You sign in directly with SoundScout. This app never stores your password, only the session (valid for 30 days).
login.useWindow: Sign in with the login window
login.altToggle: Captcha check failing? Sign in with a browser session
login.altStep1: <open>Open soundscout.com in your browser</open> and sign in as usual.
login.altStep2: Press F12 to open the developer tools → Application (Chrome/Edge) or Storage (Firefox) → Cookies → https://www.soundscout.com.
login.altStep3: Copy the value of the goldloginz entry and paste it here:
login.cookieWarning: This value is your login – don't share it. The app only keeps it in its own cookie storage.

home.notSignedIn: You're not signed in – streams are limited to 30-second previews and downloads are disabled.

account.title: SoundScout account
account.signInInfo: You sign in through the official SoundScout window (incl. captcha/2FA). This app never stores your password.

downloads.placeholdersHint: “/” separates folders, empty brackets are removed.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Embedded in every file: title, artists, album artist, album, track number/total, release date, all genres, BPM, key, ISRC, UPC/barcode, catalog number, label, brand (grouping), copyright, moods, themes, instruments, lyrics, explicit flag, Copyright Safe status, cover and the SoundScout track/release ID (so the library can recognize files).

discord.title: Discord status
discord.enable: Show what I'm listening to in Discord
discord.hint: Requires the Discord desktop app on this computer. Shows title, artist, cover and progress as “Listening to …” – clicking the song, artist or cover opens it on SoundScout. Hidden while paused.

stats.title: Listening statistics
stats.enable: Collect listening statistics for your Field Report
stats.hint: Stored only on this computer: what you play, for how long and when, plus favorites, searches and downloads.

queue.restoredPaused: Unfinished downloads from your last session – click “Resume” to continue.
queue.signInRequired: Not signed in – please sign in, then resume.
